stories.title: Japanese technology company to create 200 new jobs
stories.summary: NTT DATA is investing around £23m to create an Artificial Intelligence centre in Derry.

stories.title: Man accused of murdering Chloe Mitchell lied repeatedly, court hears
stories.summary: Brandon Rainey denies a charge of murder and a charge of preventing the lawful burial of Chloe Mitchell's remains.

stories.title: PSNI repeats apology to Pat Finucane's family during inquiry
stories.summary: The Pat Finucane Inquiry is in its opening stages and has not yet begun hearing evidence.

stories.title: Police officer sacked after sending sexualised messages to vulnerable woman
stories.summary: The chief executive of the Police Ombudsman's Office says the officer had shown "all the hallmarks of predatory behaviour".

stories.title: Smell leads police to discover 'substantial' cannabis factory
stories.summary: Two men located inside the property were arrested on suspicion of a range of drugs offences including cannabis cultivation

stories.title: Irish reality star dances her way to final of Dancing with the Stars
stories.summary: Higgin's US career has taken off following her time on the US version of The Traitors which saw her go all the way to the final as a faithful.

stories.title: Pupils served life lessons from pickleball-playing pensioners
stories.summary: Pickleball and pensioners are helping A-Level students in Belfast learn beyond their school classroom.

stories.title: DUP accused of 'anti-Irish bigotry' as education bill blocked
stories.summary: The bill would have required the Department of Education to prepare a workforce plan for schools where all subjects are taught in Irish.

stories.title: All-Ireland winners Mayo host Donegal in league opener
stories.summary: Division One champions Donegal will face All-Ireland winners Mayo in the first round of the Allianz Football League.

stories.title: Nurses vote for industrial action over pay
stories.summary: Nurses will take continuous action short of strike from 3 December - such action includes working to rule and a ban on overtime.

stories.title: PM declines meeting with Stormont ministers over budget stalemate
stories.summary: Michelle O'Neill and Emma Little-Pengelly jointly wrote to the prime minister seeking the direct engagement in a bid to resolve the seven-month impasse.

stories.title: 'There was no warning sign' - calls for more education to reduce suicide in men and boys
stories.summary: Seamus Waites says there was "no warning" before his 22-year-old son died by suicide 10 years ago.
